symbols.why: Legend (map index): r restriction, X major restriction, s silt, wavy arrow flow direction, underlined number water depth in feet, end-of-daylight-zone symbol (at the cenote entrances), slope. Four underlined depths (59', 56', 45', 46'), found by searching the underline bars too (OCR misread all four: added by hand; the '13' of '13 Conc lake room' dropped). Two flow arrows, both pointing about south. No bones (no legend icon, no bone drawn or written). The end-of-daylight-zone symbols are the entrances.

unverified: No cenote of Nohoch Kiin has a position taken on site: the database's Nohoch Kiin point (shared with Chica Kiin) is Gerrard 2015, and Northwest, Quatro Entrances, Myrna's Gift, No Eye Stage, Breathold, Chupa Cabra's Retreat and Mak Mak have no position; no cenote pond shows on the imagery (closed canopy). The map is placed only by matching its passages to the QRSS 2012 overview (sac-actun-mpo-tulum), itself a coarse 9.5 m/px plot.
placementWhy: Guess (unverified): the control points are spots of this map put through an ICP match of its traced walls onto the survey lines of the QRSS 2012 Sac Actun overview (sac-actun-mpo-tulum, placed on trusted cenotes elsewhere), scale held at the map's scale bar (0.990 m/px), searched over rotations -30..30 deg, scales 0.9-1.6 and shifts +-400 m: best at scale 1.0, map turned 7.6 deg clockwise of its north arrow. The shapes match unambiguously (the western ring passage with 45', the NW-entrance cluster, the two loops at the south end), but the 1997 drawing is distorted against the 2012 survey: with the arrow's north kept (-1.5 deg) the south half matches to 9-10 m median (walls against centrelines) and the north half to 22-28 m; at -7.6 deg the four bands are 11/20/11/13 m - kept. The scale bar and the overview agree (an extra scale didn't help). The whole cave lands about 450 m NE of where the database's Nohoch Kiin point would put a naive placement; that database point (Gerrard 2015) falls on the ring's north passage, between Breath hold and Myrna's gift, close to the overview's own Nohoch Kin dot (78 m off it). Imagery (Mapbox/Esri Maxar): continuous canopy, the power-line track south of the cave, highway 307 to the east; no pond to check against.
